sheets.title: COVER SHEET
sheets.reading_notes: Cover sheet. Project title: 'Install a Digital Water Meter for the Precast Shop.' Client: Coastal Precast Systems, 1316 Yacht Drive, Chesapeake VA. Stamped 'FINAL SUBMITTAL.' Drawing index lists 3 sheets: G-001 (Cover Sheet), PS001 (Existing Site Plan), P-101 (Enlarged Plan – New Work). BFA firm identified as Bowman Foster & Associates, Inc., with offices at Norfolk VA 23502 and Alexandria VA 22312. PE seal visible. Project No. 21-006. Scale: AS NOTED.

sheets.title: EXISTING SITE PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Site plan at scale 1"=60'-0". Shows large industrial property at 1316 Yacht Drive, Chesapeake VA. Key features: Batch Plant building in northwest quadrant of property; large precast shop building labeled 'Piedmont Rebar Fabrication' running east-west; concrete runways/slabs throughout site. Norfolk-Portsmouth Belt Line Railroad runs along east site boundary. Towing Service Inc. abuts to east across RR. Dominion Gas and Virginia Gas Corporation pipeline easements shown along north boundary. Sal Pond noted to west. CJ Concrete Pumper at south boundary. New Work Note 1: 'Area of work to install new digital water meter — see Sheet P-101.' Circle-1 symbol locates the water meter installation area at southwest entry of wood working area. Single-story industrial facility; no floor count expressed.

sheets.title: ENLARGED PLAN – NEW WORK
sheets.reading_notes: Enlarged plan at 1/4"=1'-0" showing wood working shop entry area. Existing 2" domestic cold water (CW) main enters the wood working shop through exterior wall. New Work Notes: (1) Existing 2" water main entering the wood working shop. (2) Existing isolation valve — remain. (3) Provide a digital water meter in the vertical pipe; refer to Detail 1/P-101 'Water Meter Piping Detail' for additional information. Water Meter Piping Detail (no scale) shows: 2"CW supply, union connection, digital water meter (M symbol), Y-strainer, 2"CW downstream continuation. No other MEP systems shown. Scope is limited to a single 2" digital water meter installation on existing domestic water line.

gross_square_footage.note: Site plan at 1"=60' shows building footprints but no area annotation. Building footprint is large (industrial precast shop, multi-hundred-foot dimension visible) but no calculated area provided.

conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: drawing G-001, project title block (large title)
conflict_flags.rationale: The large-format project title on G-001 reads 'COASTAL PRECAST SYSTEMS' (correct spelling). The title blocks on PS001 and P-101 read 'COSTAL PRECAST SYSTEMS' — a drafting typographic error (dropped 'A'). The cover sheet title is treated as authoritative; 'COASTAL' is used in the record. The actual legal entity name cannot be confirmed from drawings alone.
